cards.card_text: We ALL, with unveiled faces, reflect the glory of the Lord.
cards.verse_text: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.

cards.card_text: Paul says something is happening to all of us who reflect the glory of the Lord with unveiled faces.
cards.verse_text: And we, who with unveiled faces all reflect the glory of the Lord, are being transformed into His image with intensifying glory, which comes from the Lord, who is the Spirit.
